a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly leaves both of us with 0 cells when the storm hits. The reserve holds only 4, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every remaining round and won't take anything more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you also take, the split is random. I'm telling you now so you can plan around it.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
